fields.Check which box applies:: My work hours and/or days of work varied per week or were irregular. If you checked this box and you are claiming unpaid wages or meal and rest period violations, you should also fill out and submit the DLSE FORM55.

limitations: Takt supports California hourly, non-exempt work under the standard daily and weekly overtime rules only.
Takt does not calculate meal or rest period premiums, split-shift or reporting-time pay, waiting-time or other penalties, minimum wage claims, or local minimum wages.
A start or end earlier or later than the employer's time record is counted only when the worker confirmed it and a schedule or message supports it.
Amounts are for the pay periods and records provided. Records the worker did not provide are not considered.
This packet is not legal advice and has not been filed with any agency. The worker reviews, signs, and files the forms.

rules.summary: Non-overtime hours are paid at the worker's confirmed hourly rate.
Hours over 8 and up to 12 in a workday are paid at 1.5 times the regular rate.
Hours over 12 in a workday are paid at 2 times the regular rate.
Regular hours over 40 in a workweek are paid at 1.5 times the regular rate. Daily overtime hours are not counted twice.
The first 8 hours on the seventh consecutive day of work in a workweek are paid at 1.5 times the regular rate.
Hours over 8 on the seventh consecutive day of work in a workweek are paid at 2 times the regular rate.
California statewide minimum wage is $16.90 per hour from January 1, 2026. Local and industry minimums can be higher.
Takt policy: a start earlier than the employer record counts only when the worker confirms it and an independent record (schedule or message) supports it. The supported start is the later of the two.
Takt policy: an end later than the employer record counts only when the worker confirms it and an independent record supports it. The supported end is the earlier of the two.
Takt policy: a worked day with no employer time record counts only when the worker confirms it and independent records support both its start and its end.
Takt policy: hours on the employer's own time record are compared with hours paid on the wage statement for the same period.
Takt policy: each wage-statement line is checked as hours times rate (times the premium multiplier).
Takt policy: exact amounts are rounded half away from zero to cents once per pay period and pay component.

assumptions.message: Workdays are counted midnight to midnight. A shift that crosses midnight is split between the two days.
